CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid Themer — a generic theming plugin for the **Unraid 7** webGUI.
Pick a bundled theme or build your own from 8 colors, browse a built-in theme store, swap the UI icons for 9 open-source icon sets (or override any single icon), and set your own background image and logo. Non-destructive: disable it and the webGUI is 100% stock.
Source, issues and docs: https://github.com/benjaminmue/unraid-themer
